checks.requirement_quote: 构建一个智能鱼缸环境维持系统，使用水温传感器 LM35（A1）、光敏电阻 A0、水位传感器 A2、加热器 D10、照明 LED D9、水泵或增氧泵 D5、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和蜂鸣器 D6。系统根据水温控制加热器，根据环境光照控制鱼缸照明，根据水位控制增氧泵保护；若水位过低则关闭相关设备并报警。按钮 D2 可切换显示水温、光照和水位。

coverage_explanation: Executed exploratory core scenario with explicitly disclosed interface uncertainty.
assumptions: Raw stated TM1637 D4/D5 wiring is retained. Several original questions assign that same pin to another device; no silent rewiring is performed.
These scenarios cover explicit observable core paths; unspecified thresholds, configuration UI and command grammar prevent complete conformance coverage.
LM35 bench temperatures are approximately 10 and 80 C; A2 low means low water. Exact application setpoints were not supplied.
Conditional bench: original pin conflicts are resolved by the existing configuration policy; see reconstructed_bench_configuration.json. Raw-wiring results remain separate.
